newsitem.title: FINLAND: ASKO TO SELL MOLD UNIT TO MANAGEMENT.
newsitem.headline: ASKO TO SELL MOLD UNIT TO MANAGEMENT.

text.p: Finnish furniture and plastic pipe maker Asko Oy's plastic pipe division Uponor Oy said on Friday it would sell a majority stake in its form maker Tooler Oy to the management for an undisclosed sum.
"The final agreements are due to be signed by the end of November," Uponor said.
The unit's net sales are about 30 million markka, 90 percent in exports, and it employs 90 people, it said.
"Uponor is giving up its ownership of Tooler since metal industry is not part of the company's basic strategy which is in plactic pipes systems," it said.
